# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m158 engine update**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 moves to Skia m158 while preserving the existing managed binding surface. The new package line also corrects calling-convention metadata for source-generated native imports. HarfBuzz remains at native version 14.4.0; its package revision advances without an engine upgrade.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without adding managed APIs or C bridge exports. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))

## Bug Fixes

- **Explicit cdecl source-generated imports** — LibraryImport declarations now specify the same cdecl convention as the existing DllImport paths across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp and the extension bindings. This addresses an ABI mismatch relevant to Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))
